name: Service Discovery
description: Discover your connected services once — agents remember your tools and services in future.
examples: Discover all my Railway projects and services and remember them
Map my Vercel projects and domains into memory
Learn my Slack channels so you stop looking them up every time
Refresh what you know about my Railway services
long_description: Service Discovery teaches an agent to enumerate the infrastructure behind your connected integrations — Railway projects, services, environments and domains; Vercel projects and domains; Notion data sources; Slack channels — and persist the durable identifiers to its permanent memory with disciplined hygiene: compact facts, consistent tags, refresh-by-replacement, and never any secrets. Discovery runs once; every future session starts already knowing your stack. It can also seed another agent's memory with the discovered IDs, so a coordinator can hand a deploy agent exactly the identifiers it needs.
